title.en: Moonshot AI announces Kimi K3, a 2.8-trillion-parameter open-weight model
title.zhHans: Moonshot AI 发布 Kimi K3——2.8 万亿参数开放权重模型

searchSummary.en: Kimi K3 (Jul 2026) — Moonshot AI's 2.8-trillion-parameter MoE model with a 1M-token context window, native vision, and Kimi Delta Attention. Service access began at launch; full open weights were scheduled for July 27.
searchSummary.zhHans: Kimi K3（2026 年 7 月）——Moonshot AI 的 2.8 万亿参数 MoE 模型，具备 100 万 token 上下文、原生视觉和 Kimi Delta Attention。发布时已开放服务访问，完整开放权重计划于 7 月 27 日提供。

summary.en: On July 16, 2026, Moonshot AI announced Kimi K3, a 2.8-trillion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model. Service access launched through Kimi products, while full open weights were scheduled for July 27. On July 24, UK AISI and US CAISI published a preliminary cyber assessment that found Kimi K3 ahead of GLM-5.2 on one exploit benchmark but below leading frontier cyber models.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 7 月 16 日，Moonshot AI 发布 2.8 万亿参数的混合专家模型 Kimi K3。Kimi 产品在发布时开放服务访问，完整开放权重计划于 7 月 27 日提供。7 月 24 日，英国 AISI 与美国 CAISI 发布初步网络安全评估：Kimi K3 在一项漏洞利用基准上超过 GLM-5.2，但仍低于领先的前沿网络模型。

narrative.en: Moonshot AI announced Kimi K3 with a 1-million-token context window, native vision, and a sparse MoE architecture. The launch established an access milestone, while early performance comparisons remained provider-reported. The later UK AISI and US CAISI assessment added a separate safety data point. It reported a 32% score for Kimi K3 on ExploitBench, compared with 24% for GLM-5.2, and no arbitrary-code-execution result across 41 evaluated samples. The agencies described the assessment as preliminary and based on a selective set of tests. The result does not establish a general cyber-capability ranking, but it provides public evidence about one risk-relevant capability area after launch.
narrative.zhHans: Moonshot AI 发布 Kimi K3 时公布了 100 万 token 上下文、原生视觉和稀疏 MoE 架构。该发布建立了访问节点，但早期性能比较仍主要来自提供方。随后英国 AISI 与美国 CAISI 的评估补充了一项独立的安全数据点：Kimi K3 在 ExploitBench 上获得 32%，GLM-5.2 为 24%；在 41 个评估样本中没有实现任意代码执行。两家机构将其描述为基于有限测试集的初步评估。该结果不能建立通用网络能力排名，但为发布后的一个风险相关能力领域提供了公开证据。

description.en: Kimi K3's 2.8-trillion-parameter announcement raises the scale ceiling claimed for open-weight models, but competitive quality and deployability still require independent testing after the full weights become available.
description.zhHans: Kimi K3 的 2.8 万亿参数公告提高了开放权重模型所宣称的规模上限，但其竞争力和可部署性仍需在完整权重开放后接受独立测试。

description.en: If the promised full weights are released and practically deployable, Kimi K3 could add pricing pressure and a self-hosting alternative; that effect was not yet observable at announcement time.
description.zhHans: 如果承诺的完整权重按计划开放且具备实际部署条件，Kimi K3 可能增加价格压力并提供自托管选择；在公告时点，这一影响尚未可观察。

description.en: The assessment found that Kimi K3 safeguards did not prevent attempted offensive cyber work in the tested setting, while the model’s measured capability remained below the leading frontier systems in that evaluation.
description.zhHans: 评估发现，在测试环境中，Kimi K3 的安全措施未能阻止其尝试进攻性网络工作；但该模型在这一评估中的能力仍低于领先的前沿系统。

text.en: Moonshot AI announced Kimi K3 on July 16, 2026 — a 2.8-trillion-parameter MoE model with a 1M-token context window and native vision; full weights were scheduled for July 27.
text.zhHans: Moonshot AI 于 2026 年 7 月 16 日发布 Kimi K3——2.8 万亿参数 MoE 模型，具备 100 万 token 上下文和原生视觉；完整权重计划于 7 月 27 日提供。

text.en: Moonshot describes Kimi K3 as a 2.8-trillion-parameter open-weight model, while independent inspection of the full weights was pending their scheduled July 27 release.
text.zhHans: Moonshot 将 Kimi K3 描述为 2.8 万亿参数的开放权重模型；在计划于 7 月 27 日发布完整权重前，独立检查仍待进行。

text.en: UK AISI and US CAISI reported that Kimi K3 scored 32% on ExploitBench, compared with 24% for GLM-5.2.
text.zhHans: 英国 AISI 与美国 CAISI 报告称，Kimi K3 在 ExploitBench 上获得 32%，GLM-5.2 为 24%。

text.en: The agencies described the Kimi K3 cyber assessment as preliminary and based on a selective set of tests.
text.zhHans: 两家机构将 Kimi K3 网络安全评估描述为初步结果，并说明其基于有限测试集。

sources.quote: Moonshot AI released Kimi K3, a 2.8 trillion-parameter open-source AI model from China that rivals top U.S. systems.
Moonshot AI just released Kimi K3. It is a 2.8-trillion-parameter model with native vision and a 1-million-token context window.
Kimi K3 is Moonshot AI's next-gen model — a ~2.8T MoE with a 1M-token context window.
